name: Karin Karlsbro - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council suspending certain parts of Regulation (EU) 2015/478 as regards imports of Ukrainian products into the European Union
part_text:
The European Union currently limits how much of certain goods can come in from Ukraine. This report backs a plan to pause those limits for Ukrainian products. It also changes the plan so the pause runs for a fixed three years, from 6 June 2025 to 5 June 2028. The original plan would have renewed itself automatically every three years. Parliament wants a clear end date instead, so the pause cannot continue without a new decision.

- **What changes:** Import limits on Ukrainian goods are paused for a fixed three years, with no automatic renewal.
- **Who it affects:** Ukrainian exporters and European Union businesses and consumers who trade in these goods.
- **What happens next:** Parliament has set its position; talks with the Council of the European Union follow before the law can take effect.
